alternatives.argument: This is an explicit finite-dimensional definition, not a theorem inferred from Mitter–Viallet. It specifies X, K, the smooth right action, embedded slice, defining submersion, positive densities, orbit derivative, operator, and density ratio. The antecedent bundle/connection conventions are supplied by the exact batch-2 carriers; the full gauge group is separately defined. No claim from the unstamped source is required.

The local theorem is proved in the carrier: the submanifold chart and surjective defining map give adapted coordinates by the Euclidean inverse theorem; the derivative of Psi has diagonal blocks M_s0 and identity, hence is invertible; dividing its determinant by the declared source density gives the stated Jacobian and compactly supported change of variables; at each transverse zero the left-invariant frame identifies DF_x with M, the FP factor cancels its density Jacobian, finite cutoffs isolate each root, and the compact remainder vanishes while continuity and unit mollifier mass give one test-function value per distinct root.
